capabilities: Toggle auto-hide separately for the left, right, or both sidebars
Reveal sidebars by hovering the matching screen edge
Float sidebars over the editor in overlay mode
Configure sidebar width, trigger zone, vertical padding, and collapse delay
Control the plugin via ribbon icons, command palette, and settings tab
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.0.0+); manual installation from GitHub releases is described, with cleanup of sidebar classes when the plugin is disabled.
problem: Obsidian's sidebars take up writing space and lack built-in auto-hide, so users must repeatedly toggle them manually to reclaim editor space.
summary: Sidebar control plugin that adds independent auto-hide, edge-hover reveal, and overlay mode for Obsidian's left and right sidebars on desktop.
